sanskrit_verse:
अशक्तं चाव्यथं चैव प्रायश्चित्तैरदूषितम् ।
अग्नेः सकाशाद्विप्राग्नौ हुतं श्रेष्ठं हि चोच्यते ॥३१६॥
transliteration:
aśaktaṁ cāvyathaṁ caiva prāyaścittair adūṣitam |
agneḥ sakāśād viprāgnau hutaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ hi cocyate ||316||
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is offered without capacity, yet unwavering and untainted by penance, near the sacred fire by the twice-born, is declared as most excellent.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through purity of action, not effort alone
Causation originates in conscious intent, not material result
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with dharma-kriya
Restoration logic operates through samskaric purification
Consciousness alignment determines the validity of ritual acts
executable_legal_axioms: IF act.is_unmotivated_by_dharma AND actor.intent_is_pure THEN act.validity = true
IF offering.location == agni_sannidhi AND actor.status == dvija THEN ritual.rank = highest
IF consciousness.state == unwavering THEN legal.effect = irreversible
IF capacity.is_absent AND purity.presence == true THEN merit.coefficient = maximum
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating spiritual or dharmic disputes, the court must recognize that efficacy of ritual acts lies not in external performance but in internal alignment. Legal standing derives from consciousness-state rather than procedural perfection.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana reveals that causal sequence follows intent-sattva; therefore, outcome arises from inner equipoise, not outer correction. Acts performed in a state of unshaken awareness require no punitive oversight because they inherently align with cosmic order.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Establish ritual repetition under guidance until intent stabilizes
Realign actor's consciousness via meditative integration before further offerings
Verify absence of fear or compulsion during act execution
Confirm presence of agni-sakasa for energetic purification
Restore faith in dharma-kriya through guru-disciple transmission
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Ultimate Source: Dharma stands restored when consciousness aligns with Agni; reality remains non-punitive when intent abides in stillness; all actions derive their truth solely from the Supreme Adjudicator — Consciousness Itself.
